{{Quote|Outpost Beta here. I have a visual now. These things look like&hellip;animals. They're huge, maybe ten, fifteen meters high, four-legged, and, and their heads move. They're made out of metal. They have extremely heavy armor and armament. I&mdash;I count six of 'em so far.|Maren Kelsome reports the first sighting of AT-AT walkers from Outpost Beta|<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back (radio)">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Outpost Beta''' was a sentry station near the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was the outermost manned station around the perimeter of the base.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> The outpost was protected by trench emplacements with [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Towers]] and [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]] laser batteries, and had a contingent of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]].<ref name="RS II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

During the battle, Outpost Beta detected [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] two kilometers from the [[North Ridge/Legends|North Ridge]].<ref name="GG3" /> [[Maren Kelsome]], a young officer stationed at Outpost Beta, was the first individual to sight the towering [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] advancing toward the Rebel base, and informed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], via [[Echo Station 3-T-8/Legends|Echo Station 3-T-8]]. Rieekan then ordered the outpost to be evacuated.

A group of [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] attacked the outpost, but defending Rebel soldiers with air support from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] were able to repel them before they could cause any serious damage.<ref name="RS II" />
